question: Why do we retry failed requests?

steps.label: Merging people who use more than one name

short_answer.text: The team decided to go with "Wait longer after each failed try". This spreads out retry attempts naturally so recovered services have breathing room.
The team decided to go with "Fail health checks fast without retrying". Health checks should fail fast rather than retrying so unhealthy nodes leave the pool immediately.
The team decided to go with "Cap total retry wait". Caps backoff at 10 seconds total across all attempts so requests do not hang indefinitely.

based_on: Based on 6 comments in pull request #176 and 5 comments in #170.
